payload.title: Tidewater 1.8 release planning
payload.summary:
Release planning for Tidewater 1.8.

## Decisions

- Tidewater 1.8 ships on Thursday 1 October.

## Notes

- rc2 is ready on Monday and goes to the full regression.
- The UTC-only tide table loader is in.

action_items.text: Tell the harbour office the release date

transcript.speaker: Tobias Wrenfield
transcript.text: rc2 is ready on Monday. We could ship on Thursday the first.

transcript.speaker: Hallie Marsh
transcript.text: The first is the harbour's quarterly inspection. The harbour office asks for no changes to its systems that day.

transcript.speaker: Mira Castellane
transcript.text: Then not Thursday. Let's ship on Tuesday the sixth of October.

transcript.speaker: Priya Lanthorn
transcript.text: Tuesday the sixth, agreed. I'll tell the harbour office.

transcript.speaker: Oksana Peregud
transcript.text: Then I run the full regression on rc2 by Wednesday.

payload.title: Quick call: 1.8 release
payload.summary: The call ended after two minutes; no notes were taken.
